branch.description: Git branch name (only used if pathOrGit is a Git URL)

exclude.description: Exclude pattern for project names (e.g., 'Test' to skip test projects)

include.description: Include pattern for project names (e.g., 'Core' to only analyze projects containing 'Core')

maxDiagnostics.description: Maximum number of diagnostics to return (default: 100)

pathOrGit.description: Path to solution file or directory containing .sln file, or Git repository URL

severity.description: Minimum severity level to include: Error, Warning, Info, or Hidden

allowIntroducedErrors.description: If false (the default), fixes whose result introduces compiler errors are refused and nothing is written: the response carries the patch and the introduced errors with applied=false. Set true to write them anyway.

ids.description: List of diagnostic IDs to fix (e.g., ['RCS1213', 'SA1101'])

max.description: Maximum diagnostics returned in each verification list (default 20); the remainder are counted in verification.omitted.

previewOnly.description: If true (the default), only preview changes and return a diff — no files are modified. Set explicitly to false to apply the fixes and write changes to disk.

project.description: Project name, directory, .csproj, or .sln path. Optional — if omitted, RoselineMCP auto-discovers the solution/project from its working directory.

max.description: Maximum number of errors to return (default: 20); the remainder are counted in `omitted`.

project.description: Project name, directory, .csproj, or .sln path. Optional — if omitted, RoselineMCP auto-discovers the solution/project from its working directory.

fileName.description: Optional file name for the patch header (default: 'file.txt')

ignoreCase.description: If true, ignore case differences when computing the diff (default: false)

ignoreWhitespace.description: If true, ignore whitespace-only differences (trailing spaces, run-length) when computing the diff (default: false)

allowIntroducedErrors.description: If false (the default), an edit that introduces compiler errors is refused and nothing is written: the response carries the diff and the introduced errors with applied=false. Set true to write it anyway.

max.description: Maximum diagnostics returned in each verification list (default 20); the remainder are counted in verification.omitted.

newSource.description: New C# member declaration source (required for 'replace' and 'add'; ignored for 'delete')

previewOnly.description: If true (the default), only preview the change and return a diff — no files are modified. Set explicitly to false to write the change to disk.

project.description: Project name, directory, .csproj, or .sln path. Optional — if omitted, RoselineMCP auto-discovers the solution/project from its working directory.

symbol.description: For 'replace'/'delete': the member to edit. For 'add': the container type to add a member to. Simple or fully-qualified name.

max.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 100)

project.description: Project name, directory, .csproj, or .sln path. Optional — if omitted, RoselineMCP auto-discovers the solution/project from its working directory.

symbol.description: Interface, class, or member to find implementations/overrides/derived types for (simple or fully-qualified name)

includeDefinition.description: If true, also include the symbol's own declaration among the results (default: false)

max.description: Maximum number of reference locations to return (default: 100)

project.description: Project name, directory, .csproj, or .sln path. Optional — if omitted, RoselineMCP auto-discovers the solution/project from its working directory.

symbol.description: Symbol to find references for: a simple name or a fully-qualified name to disambiguate

max.description: Maximum number of nodes to expand per direction (default: 50)

method.description: Method to build the graph around (simple or fully-qualified name)

project.description: Project name, directory, .csproj, or .sln path. Optional — if omitted, RoselineMCP auto-discovers the solution/project from its working directory.

column.description: Optional 1-based column. Omit to resolve the most relevant symbol on the line (declarations win over references).

file.description: File to resolve the position in (name or path suffix, e.g. 'UserService.cs' or 'Services/UserService.cs')

project.description: Project name, directory, .csproj, or .sln path. Optional — if omitted, RoselineMCP auto-discovers the solution/project from its working directory.

includeSource.description: If true (the default), include the exact source text of the symbol's declaration

project.description: Project name, directory, .csproj, or .sln path. Optional — if omitted, RoselineMCP auto-discovers the solution/project from its working directory.

symbol.description: Symbol to describe: a simple name (e.g. 'UserService') or a fully-qualified name (e.g. 'Acme.Users.UserService.GetUser') to disambiguate

max.description: Maximum number of derived types to return (default: 100)

project.description: Project name, directory, .csproj, or .sln path. Optional — if omitted, RoselineMCP auto-discovers the solution/project from its working directory.

type.description: Type to inspect (simple or fully-qualified name)

files.description: Optional list of file patterns to filter (e.g., ['Controller.cs', 'Service.cs'])

ids.description: Optional list of diagnostic IDs to filter (e.g., ['CS0168', 'CS0219'])

max.description: Maximum number of diagnostic details to return (default: 100)

project.description: Project name, directory, .csproj, or .sln path. Optional — if omitted, RoselineMCP auto-discovers the solution/project from its working directory.

allowIntroducedErrors.description: If false (the default), a rename that introduces compiler errors — including in a downstream project the caller never named — is refused and nothing is written: the response carries the diff and the introduced errors with applied=false. Set true to write it anyway.

max.description: Maximum diagnostics returned in each verification list (default 20); the remainder are counted in verification.omitted.

newName.description: New name for the symbol (must be a valid C# identifier)

previewOnly.description: If true (the default), only preview the rename and return a diff — no files are modified. Set explicitly to false to write the changes to disk.

project.description: Project name, directory, .csproj, or .sln path. Optional — if omitted, RoselineMCP auto-discovers the solution/project from its working directory.

symbol.description: Symbol to rename (simple or fully-qualified name)

file.description: Optional file (name or path suffix) to restrict the search to, or to outline when 'query' is omitted

kinds.description: Optional kind filter, e.g. ['class','interface','method','property','field','enum']; also accepts 'type' and 'member'

max.description: Maximum number of symbols to return (default: 50)

project.description: Project name, directory, .csproj, or .sln path. Optional — if omitted, RoselineMCP auto-discovers the solution/project from its working directory.

query.description: Name pattern to match (substring, or wildcard with * and ?, e.g. '*Service' or 'Get*'). Omit to outline a single file via the 'file' parameter.
